notes.title: Patch Notes v 0.7.0
notes.notes:
[h2]CONTENT[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added up to 40 new cards to the Inspector's deck.
[*] Added the 'Backstab' keyword to the Inspector's playstyle.
[*] Added the 'Faster' keyword to the Inspector's playstyle.
[*] Added more cards that use 'Fragile'.
[*] Added a new altered state, Rush. Now, whenever anyone gains or loses speed, it will be visually shown by Rush.
[*] Added up to 40 new gadgets.
[*] Removed 3 combats from Handy Cut.
[*] Added 6 new combats to Handy Cut, one of them being a boss.
[*] Added a new Character Selector screen. You can now see Inspector's initial stats. Being the demo, the Detective's button is deactivated.
[*] Added a new map. Updated the artwork of Tubercle City on the Map screen.
[/list]

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed the Clues altered state.
[*] Reworked all the cards that used Clues in some way.
[*] Reworked all the cards from the Inspector that had no archetype defined with the removal of Clues.
[*] Reworked 4 enemy passives from Handy Cut.
[*] Adjusted all the enemy intentions so that Easy Combats feel like a tutorial and from there scales on a fair difficulty.
[*] Added to each Event one of two tiers, so that depending on which one it has, it will only be able to appear in the first/second or third events from each zone.
[*] Removed the option to pay for resting, replacing it with a remove card option that costs the same as resting did.
[/list]

[h2]UI AND EFFECTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated the cursor.
[*] Updated the description boxes.
[*] Improved the Upgrade Card screen. Now, when you select one, the upgrade is on the right of the non-upgraded one, so you can clearly see what it upgrades.
[*] Improved the Events options so that are less ambiguous.
[*] Replaced some fonts.
[*] Added feedback to dealing damage.
[*] Added feedback to gaining Armor.
[*] Added feedback to using Equipment cards.
[*] Added feedback to activating gadgets.
[*] Added feedback to applying altered states.
[*] Added feedback to activating passives.
[*] Improved combat sound fx.
[*] Improved map sound fx.
[*] Improved shop sound fx.
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] A ton of bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Release + Discord
notes.notes:
🚀 Big news, gang! 🚀

We’re getting closer to revealing the release date for Vegangsters – our strategy deckbuilder roguelike! 🃏🌱

We can’t say much yet, but one thing’s for sure: 2025 is the year. ⏳

To celebrate, we've launched a new Discord so the community can discuss strategies, report bugs, give suggestions, and more!
